budget._doc: The owner's $13/week covers every LLM call of the whole fund (all desks, R5, lifecycle, review, this desk). The OpenRouter key showed $9.67 for Mon-Fri of the week of 2026-10-12 and $14.93 for 1-16 Oct, so this desk gets a small share: ~$2/week. Hard stop: the desk's LLM calls stop for the UTC day once its spend (provider usage x live OpenRouter price) reaches usd_day_stop. Probe estimate for this set with reasoning off for both stages: tagging ~$0.10/day + ledger ~$0.18/day (upper bound) = ~$0.28/day.

llm.selection: The node-contract test picks the model: the same 200 cluster->firm items (headlines and transcript windows) through each candidate, owner-checked; the cheapest candidate with precision >= 0.9 (and, for windows, recall >= 0.8 against the union of what any candidate found and the owner confirmed) is frozen with the PREREG amendment. The ledger uses the same model and setting.
llm._doc: This desk only. The traded fund's model is frozen by Protocol 7 (a change restarts the protocol), and R5's by its pre-registration.

whisper._doc: Local, Apple Silicon only. YouTube blocks caption requests within ~21 calls, so active video goes through audio + whisper (~17x real time on the M4; ~150 compute-min/day for this set).
